findings.message: public.things.naive is timestamp without time zone
findings.reason: the column stores a wall clock reading with no offset, so the instant it denotes depends on whoever reads it
findings.fix: change the column to timestamptz, or set strict.timestamp_without_tz: off if the ambiguity is intended

findings.message: public.things.amount has no configured Go mapping for numeric
findings.reason: there is no lossless built-in Go type for an arbitrary-precision decimal, and mapping it to float64 would silently corrupt money
findings.fix:
add a types.numeric entry to orm.yaml:
types:
  numeric:
    go: github.com/shopspring/decimal.Decimal
    codec: decimal

findings.message: public.things.ref has no configured Go mapping for uuid
findings.reason: Go has no uuid type, and the popular third-party ones are not interchangeable
findings.fix:
add a types.uuid entry to orm.yaml:
types:
  uuid:
    go: github.com/google/uuid.UUID
    codec: uuid

findings.message: Span is string but public.things.span is interval
Quota is orm.Range[int64] but public.things.quota is int4range
public.things.price has the unsupported type numrange
findings.reason: numrange ranges over numeric, and numeric has no configured Go mapping: there is no lossless built-in Go type for an arbitrary-precision decimal, and mapping it to float64 would silently corrupt money. Add a types.numeric entry to orm.yaml naming a Go type such as github.com/shopspring/decimal.Decimal
findings.fix: exclude the field with orm:"-", change the column's type, or configure a mapping for the element type under types in orm.yaml

findings.message: Slots is orm.Multirange[int64] but public.things.slots is int4multirange
Window is Period but public.things.window_ is tstzrange

findings.reason: v1 maps one-dimensional arrays only; a Go slice of slices does not round-trip through PostgreSQL's nested array representation
findings.fix: store the value as a one-dimensional array, as jsonb, or exclude the field with orm:"-"
